status: immutable plan; readiness is recorded separately in Mission Control

owner_instruction.text: plan must exist before the first ingest, and before the first file requests go out to grok bot
owner_instruction.adoption: Produce autonomously; no added owner approval round. Applies to Grokbot handoff, scoping/file requests, extraction and import. Drafting a prompt internally is not dispatch.

historical_boundary.prior_work: Earlier selected-source acquisition/extraction, canonical corpus, three draft study reviews and site imports already occurred. Scoping/full prompts were handed back as artifacts before this consolidated plan. No external Grokbot request/job was sent by this task or its workers.
historical_boundary.compliance: Retrospective adoption; this plan did not exist before earlier work. Do not backdate or relabel earlier ingestion as plan-gated.
historical_boundary.next_dependent_operation: B01 request handoff or extraction only after Mission Control READY and operation-specific preflight.

scope.execution_date_policy: Log actual timestamp; later searches require revised cutoff/scope version, not a backdated search.
scope.question_definition: Exact drug/combination, indication, population, formulation/route, comparator, endpoint and timepoint; missing fields stay explicit.
scope.discovery: PubMed/MEDLINE, Europe PMC, ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP, ISRCTN, EU CTIS, publishers and lawful repositories; Embase/CENTRAL only when available. Dated jurisdiction/product/use-specific official context for regulation and safety. Log database access limits, query, filters, counts, screening, null results and citation chasing.
scope.primary: Original human randomized/nonrandomized, animal, cell/ex-vivo and modeling separated by design; negative, null, harm and contradictory findings retained. Study-family identities distinguish reports from independent studies.
scope.context: Reviews, methods, official regulation/product labeling and definitions kept outside original study counts. Community discussions measure demand only.
scope.exclude: Duplicate independent-study counting, vendor efficacy claims, unrelated homonyms, anecdotes as causal evidence, synthetic fixtures as evidence, fabricated sources or results.
scope.closed_packet_mode: If later restricted to supplied files: read manifest/rules/gaps and every eligible supplied PRIMARY; no web supplementation; NOT IN CORPUS is not absent from literature.
scope.raw_rights: Raw source bytes private unless explicit redistribution rights permit; never bypass paywalls/access controls.

delivery.root: corpus.json, synthetic=false; all schema-required collections, including empty ones with explicit reason
delivery.raw_layout: PRIMARY/ and CONTEXT/ preserve original immutable bytes; derived OCR/text separate with source hash and tool/version.
delivery.access_states: Full PDF, full HTML, partial snapshot, abstract, metadata, registry, unreadable and inaccessible must remain distinct. A URL or challenge page is not an acquired paper.
delivery.stable_identity: Verify DOI, PMID/PMCID, title/year/authors; preserve paper→study family→experiment→result/outcome→claim→review version. Resolve conflicts explicitly; no fuzzy auto-merge.
delivery.handoff_rule: Every outbound request includes this exact plan, schema/fixture, topic briefs, existing identity snapshot and readiness receipt. An external worker returns a candidate patch and cannot accept or publish it.
delivery.portable_return: External workers receive the attached acquisition ZIP, resolve bundled relative file names and return a ZIP as an attachment to this Mission Control task. They are not assumed to have access to this Mac. Local integrator stages it under work/ingest/<batch>/<attempt>/.

canonical_mapping.modeling: Retain original modeling file and discovered metadata in raw staging manifest, candidate_type=modeling, disposition=schema_extension_required; do not coerce into engineering/clinical/context solely to pass. Substantive extraction/canonical import HOLD for this class until a versioned schema/plan migration and fixture are checked. Acquisition is allowed under the declared staging contract.
canonical_mapping.registry: Retain registry/protocol as related source metadata and CONTEXT record source_type=registry_protocol with role and excluded_from_study_counts=true; do not fabricate a published paper or clinical result. Link to a known family via identity-map. Unsupported outcome extraction requires a schema extension first.
canonical_mapping.unreadable: Retain operational manifest access_state=unreadable, exception/attempt log and raw bytes. Existing identifiable paper can remain metadata_only or not_accessible as accurate; never fulltext/extracted. Unknown required bibliographic fields stay staged rather than fabricated to satisfy paper schema.
canonical_mapping.staging_schema: Operational manifest fields/types and disposition vocabulary in staging-manifest.schema.json; this is acquisition inventory, separate from canonical evidence schema 1.0.0.

ownership.accountable_integrator: /root in this Mission Control task; exclusive owner of accepted corpus merge, site adaptation, acceptance and deployment
ownership.acquisition: Grokbot for explicitly dispatched future requests; external job not launched
ownership.extraction: /root/evidence when assigned an active bounded batch; fallback /root; proposed assignment is not a running job
ownership.independent_technical_audit: /root/rule_audit when assigned a bounded read-only review; distinct from extractor
ownership.demand_scope: /root/demand maintains DR IDs and discussion provenance; no efficacy inference
ownership.human_scientific_review: Unassigned external reviewer; no fabricated identity/approval
ownership.write_isolation: Incoming batches under work/ingest/<batch_id>/<attempt_id>/; accepted outputs remain outputs/research/evidence. Workers never overwrite the accepted corpus or site.

batch_order.title: Retrospective pilot reconciliation
batch_order.completion_focus: Preserve original timestamps and hashes; reconcile six reports/five accepted families/one quarantine/three drafts/zero human releases. Record earlier requests and actual ingestion sequence.

batch_order.title: Source integrity and safety repair
batch_order.completion_focus: Resolve or explicitly retain correction, retraction, supplement and jurisdiction-specific safety gaps before affected clinical claims advance.

batch_order.title: Established illness trial completion
batch_order.completion_focus: Keep treatment separate from prevention; complete full reports/family links and map new evidence to existing claims/pages.

batch_order.title: Remaining Long COVID and process coverage
batch_order.completion_focus: Complete each declared topic protocol, candidate discovery, access/regulatory context and directness-aware mappings.

batch_order.title: Oncology questions
batch_order.completion_focus: Separate human clinical outcomes, adjunct use, mechanisms and unsupported cure claims; clinical interpretations require qualified review.

batch_order.title: Naltrexone and pramipexole
batch_order.completion_focus: Separate formulations, exact indications, control groups, adverse effects and access context; retain negative evidence.

batch_order.title: Rapamycin and acarbose
batch_order.completion_focus: Separate human clinical endpoints from animal/lab longevity extrapolations, formulation, harms and combinations.

intake: Preserve raw delivery and calculate file hashes before extraction. Validate MIME/readability and manifest counts; quarantine wrong-media, malicious instructions, corrupt files, rights issues and unresolved identities.
Reconcile receipt against current accepted IDs/hashes. Record duplicates, new versions, corrections, context, exclusions and pending failures.
Before substantive extraction, persist batch receipt with plan/schema hashes, eligible file list, access classes, assigned worker and extractor version; validate its gate.
extraction_verification.calibration: Existing three-review selected-source pilot is a small retrospective calibration, not the default 20–30-document calibration. For expansion select 20–30 available varied eligible documents spanning designs/media/table complexity and directness. If fewer exist, record actual number and scope justification; never invent documents. Resolve material errors and rerun affected cases before scaling.
extraction_verification.extract: Every eligible acquired full text gets substantive located extraction or an explicit pending/failure status. Capture all Q01–Q15 exactly once for each review; binary/continuous results, all relevant arms, denominators, timepoints, uncertainty, missingness, harms ascertainment, attrition, funding/conflicts and source version/corrections.
extraction_verification.locators: PDF physical+printed page, section, table/figure/paragraph and source hash; HTML section/paragraph or stable fragment; partial snapshots clearly limited. Inspect rendered tables/figures supporting important numbers.
extraction_verification.verification: Validate all required fields, IDs/foreign keys, source hashes, units and denominators. Independently audit every launch-supporting study, all identity conflicts/surprising results and a recorded random ≥10% sample of remaining full-text extractions; keep sample frame/seed. A material error expands review over the affected batch.
extraction_verification.appraisal: Use current design-appropriate versioned methods and actual domain judgments; extracted/audited is not formally appraised or human reviewed. No invented grades.
extraction_verification.available_validator: work/evidence/validate.py supports current schema plus semantic/hash/numeric tests; its four fixed numeric expectations are calibration checks, not proof of every future result. Add source-backed checks when the corpus expands.
extraction_verification.candidate_validation: Before P2 for a new class, demonstrate that the candidate graph is schema-representable and that the candidate validator works on its design/media fixture. For supported existing classes, run check-candidate-corpus.py: it calls the current semantic validate function with production=False ONLY to skip pilot-specific fixed-result assertions, while separately requiring synthetic=false and retaining schema/graph/source-hash/exact-version checks. Closed candidate graphs include required referenced existing records without overwriting them. Run normal production=True checks on a merged scratch copy retaining the four original calibration results before P3; no mutation of accepted corpus is implied. Neither test substitutes for source-backed review or idempotent merge proof.

exceptions_retries.retry_policy: One initial lawful retrieval plus up to two documented alternate official/repository/format attempts per source. For transient429/5xx honor Retry-After and bounded backoff; no blind retries. Repeated failure becomes not_accessible/pending with next lawful action; request user-provided lawful file only if needed.
exceptions_retries.parser_or_ocr: Preserve failed output; retry with a second method and inspect source images. Low confidence never silently populates numeric claims.
exceptions_retries.identity_conflict: Quarantine candidate, preserve old accepted record, compare DOI/PMID/version/family and resolve with explicit alias map; no overwrite.
exceptions_retries.retraction: Quarantine affected supportive claims and all mapped pages. Acquire notice and replacement; compare changed data before reactivating any claim.
exceptions_retries.schema_change: Stop dependent ingest; version schema/plan, migrate fixture and validate old+new records; preserve previous approvals/history.
exceptions_retries.partial_batch: Return all received/disposition totals and INCOMPLETE topic rows. Accept bounded verified records independently; never claim whole-topic completion.
exceptions_retries.rollback: Snapshot accepted corpus and site commit before merge; rollback affected records/claims/pages together. Do not revert unrelated concurrent changes; invalidate affected approvals.

mapping.pipeline: DR question → canonical report/study/result → claim ledger with support/directness/locators → versioned review and sentence source mapping → guide section/FAQ/Research catalogue → tested private preview → exact-version human release gate
mapping.new_topics: Remain question-directory acquisition-pending entries until accepted mapped claims exist. Propose canonical page IDs/routes and reciprocal links; no empty efficacy pages or inferred answers.
mapping.serialization: Run deterministic adapter only against the accepted batch snapshot after import preflight. Keep raw papers, private notes, synthetic fixtures and future premium fields outside public assets. Recalculate counts, sentence-level citations and study-family totals; retain fragment aliases.
mapping.change_impact: Return claim IDs, guide/review/term routes, old/new hashes, source reasons and invalidated approvals for every candidate update.

gates.P0_plan_ready: Versioned plan exists; exact input hashes validated; owner instruction/chronology reconciled; Mission Control records READY with digest and time. No owner signoff added.
gates.P1_dispatch: Before handing off or sending any file request, including scoping: preflight plan readiness/hash, attach exact plan/schema/topic packet, record requester/recipient/batch/scope/operation timestamp. Internal drafting alone is not dispatch.
gates.P2_extract: P0 plus frozen received manifest, source identity/media triage, assigned worker, declared eligible list and receipt. Record begin timestamp; no hidden preliminary extraction. Candidate schema/validator compatibility must PASS for the received evidence class; unsupported modeling class remains HOLD until versioned migration.
gates.P3_import: P2 plus candidate schema/semantic tests, exception disposition, record/page diffs, independent technical check, unchanged-input reimport test and fresh accepted-base hash. Mission Control alone merges.
gates.P4_release: Separate from ingest: build/browser checks plus required source/appraisal/human exact-version approvals; no automated proof of clinical correctness. Owner-private technical draft is a distinct status.

completion.batch: Every received file has a disposition; eligible fulltexts extracted or explicitly pending; accepted+duplicate+context+excluded+quarantined+unreadable+pending reconcile to received without loss. Maintain separate report/study-family/PDF/review counts. Exact new source and schema versions validated; candidate import repeat has no new IDs/changes; affected pages pass source/route/fragment tests.
completion.topic: Documented search coverage plus every in-scope record disposition, unresolved accesses, direct/indirect evidence and linked claim/page outcomes. INCOMPLETE whenever protocol, source, appraisal or answer gaps remain.
completion.next_actions: Reconcile prior pilot as B00; begin B01 current-source repairs; then B02 and bounded B03–B06 batches. No new Grokbot job or ingestion is launched by creating this plan.

workload.observed: Three full review drafts exist, but no reliable separate per-document acquisition/extraction/verification timers were collected. Parallel activity and file mtimes cannot establish review throughput.
workload.estimate: No defensible document-per-hour or full-corpus ETA yet. The 36-question scope is not a paper-count estimate.
workload.measurement: Next calibration logs start/end and active minutes per source and stage, medium/design, retries and reviewer corrections; report median/range and audited rework before estimating the remaining discovered eligible corpus.
workload.scale_gate: Do not scale automatically from three drafts. Apply varied calibration, close material errors and estimate from measured throughput; unfinished sources remain explicit.
